checks.name: Error-based SQL injection
checks.description: Sends SQL metacharacters and quote-breaking payloads into the point and matches the response against database error signatures (MySQL, PostgreSQL, SQLite, MSSQL, Oracle) that a correctly parameterised query would never surface.
checks.remediation: Use parameterised queries or a prepared-statement API for every database call; never build SQL by concatenating request values. Return a generic error page so database errors are not echoed to the client.

checks.name: Debug marker header exposure
checks.description: An operator-authored passive check: flags responses carrying the in-house X-Debug-Marker header, which this engagement's target leaves on when a staging build is deployed.
checks.remediation: Strip the debug header at the edge for production builds, or gate it behind an authenticated internal flag.
